title: Qman DirectPath capability policy
description: Closed, self-hashed policy input for capability and dependency-closure evaluation. Repository currentness, trusted time and policy approval remain product authority responsibilities.
x-qmanTimeRule: effectiveAt is strictly before expiresAt. A verifier accepts the document only when effectiveAt <= verifiedAt < expiresAt; the caller must source verifiedAt from a trusted clock and bind expiresAt into the admission evidence horizon.
x-qmanHashRule: Set policyHash to null in a construction-only projection, encode the complete object with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, and compute SHA-256 over those bytes. The persisted final document carries the non-null digest.
x-qmanRequestBindingRule: A VM request policyBinding must exactly equal this document's policyId, policyVersion, policyHash, admissionMode, supportedCatalogDigest, catalogSequence, trustKeyRingSequence and qualificationCaseMatrixHash. Closure roots come from the verified request; closure limits come only from this policy's dependencyClosure object.
x-qmanBoundaryRule: Schema, hash and time verification do not prove that this is the repository-current approved policy. Product code must obtain it through an independently authenticated, linearizable authority read and bind policyHash to every decision and side-effect authorization.
